connector.name: VRChat MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for VRChat friends, worlds, groups, events, notifications, and VRCX history.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vrchat-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the basic-bit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: VRCHAT_MCP_CONFIG_FILE
env.description: Path to a JSON config file for settings not supplied through environment variables.

env.name: VRCHAT_MCP_USER_AGENT
env.description: Descriptive User-Agent for VRChat API requests.

env.name: VRCHAT_MCP_COOKIE_STORE
env.description: Cookie storage backend for VRChat authentication. The keychain mode falls back to file storage if the OS keychain is unavailable.

env.name: VRCHAT_MCP_COOKIE_FILE
env.description: Cookie file path used when VRCHAT_MCP_COOKIE_STORE is file.

env.name: VRCHAT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
env.description: Allow non-GET VRChat API write operations. Defaults to true for local full-capability use; set to false for read-only mode.
